name: Play a land on turn 1-2, preferring Ugin's Labyrinth when there is something to imprint
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once a colorless card of mana value 7 or greater is in hand (an imprint target), play a land, preferring Ugin's Labyrinth first by its own printed 'mana value 7 or greater' imprint text, then a missing Urza's piece, then Eldrazi Temple, then a basic - the same three fallback tiers open-tron-land reads, reordered with Labyrinth promoted ahead of them. NOTES.md: 'Ugin's Labyrinth is the engine, not a Wastes... The correct play off a Labyrinth-plus-Devourer hand is Labyrinth exiling Devourer, not holding Devourer to cast'; hand case: T1 Eldrazi Temple + Ugin's Labyrinth + Emrakul, the Promised End (no two-mana rock in hand) plays Labyrinth. Its own hand-imprint-target count sits byte-identical in open-tron-land's own false list, so the two plays are provably exclusive (this deck has no archetype axis to partition the two lanes on, unlike eldrazi-tron's Temple/Tron/Labyrinth split): open-labyrinth-land takes over the whole land-drop decision, not only the Labyrinth preference, whenever there is something worth imprinting - its own fallback order otherwise matches open-tron-land's exactly, so no coverage is lost. Carries the same Ugin's Labyrinth may/choose_cards imprint answers, with the same mana_value >= 8 (Emrakul) then Creature (Devourer over Ugin/All Is Dust) imprint prefer. Chains into map-for-tron-missing-piece the same way. Stands down once two or more untapped mana is already up - the same key map-for-tron-missing-piece's own true condition reads, and once a two-mana artifact is also in hand: NOTES.md's own 'Opening-hand sequencing' section (a two-mana rock plus a one-land Labyrinth hand curving Labyrinth -> Mind Stone -> Expedition Map) is the seat-admitted imprint-big-colorless-on-land-drop's own true condition, so this play cedes the whole land-drop decision to it whenever that rock is present, the same take-over discipline this play already uses against open-tron-land. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
